title: Elon Musk vs Sam Altman: who will control AGI?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Elon Musk has the resources and vision to lead AGI development through OpenAI and Tesla's neural networks. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman has built a more transparent and collaborative framework at OpenAI, ensuring AGI is developed responsibly, not just for profit. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tesla’s Dojo supercomputer and real-world AI training through autonomous vehicles give Musk a unique edge in AGI deployment. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman’s governance model at OpenAI includes outside oversight and alignment research — critical for safe AGI control. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Altman’s OpenAI has the right balance of innovation and accountability — that’s who will control AGI. (4 sec)
